items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I think Raymond says he was called Pansy. [INTERVIEWEE] No, Julius Reiner is the piano, and Herman Ragus is the bass player.

ctx.x: Well, do you know how Pansy Lane got that name? Pansy Lane got that name. I think Raymond says he was called Pansy.
No, Julius Reiner is the piano, and Herman Ragus is the bass player.
